title: Tinyboost
description: This mod pack enhances your performance on laptops and Steam Decks.
body:
![ghgh](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab761ba7a668cfb1b5e25305e93fa539fc2c9b28_0.webp) -----------------------------------
Performance on my Laptop: Vanilla: 150 - 220 FPS Tinyboost: 200 - 295 FPS Tired of lag ruining your Minecraft experience on your laptop or Steam Deck? Tinyboost is a carefully curated lightweight modpack designed to dramatically improve performance without compromising the vanilla feel of the game. Whether you're using a modest laptop, a handheld like the Steam Deck, or just want a smoother experience on weaker hardware, Tinyboost offers: ⚡ Significantly improved FPS 🧠 Optimized memory usage 🧩 Modular performance tweaks using modern Fabric-based tools 💨 Faster loading times and snappier UI 🖥️ Minimal system impact, ideal for older or portable devices Tinyboost includes only the essential client-side mods to reduce lag, stutters, and resource drain. It's perfect for survival gameplay, building, or just casually exploring your worlds—smooth and responsive, just how Minecraft should be. No extra features, no clutter—just pure performance. -------------------------------------------------------------
